summary: The included contracts are largely coherent and fail-closed, with strong framework scoping, artifact validation, credential minimization, and verification-state design. Three bounded inconsistencies remain: the preflight launcher permits owner-writable helper files despite a non-writable identity claim, the Playwright publisher accepts output paths outside documented report roots, and generation rules prohibit legitimate Locator count reads more broadly than the reviewer taxonomy.

findings.title: Preflight helper may remain owner-writable
findings.evidence: The helper identity check rejects only group/world write bits, so an owner-writable helper passes even though the public generator contract describes the sibling helper as non-writable. The helper is compiled and executed as the preflight security boundary.
findings.recommendation: Either reject all write bits and recheck descriptor identity after reading, or narrow the public claim and explicitly document the same-user modification boundary.

findings.title: Publisher output is not restricted to report roots
findings.evidence: Output validation requires only two or more relative path components, permitting destinations such as `src/config.json`; the helper can then atomically replace an existing regular file despite debugger guidance limiting generated artifacts to `playwright-report/` or `blob-report/`.
findings.recommendation: Require the output path to be a direct validated descendant of the documented Playwright report root, preferably exactly `playwright-report/results.json` for this publisher.

findings.title: All Locator count reads are forbidden
findings.evidence: The generation table forbids `const n = await el.count()` without considering its use, while the included reviewer contract classifies count as a one-shot weakness only when used as an assertion substitute. Legitimate count reads used for iteration or branching therefore have no supported generation path.
findings.recommendation: Forbid count reads only when they replace a retrying assertion; explicitly permit justified operational uses where the numeric value is consumed for non-assertion logic.

limitations: Packet-only static review; no tools, execution, filesystem inspection, network access, or subagents were used.
No runtime success, benchmark accuracy, holdout performance, CI results, or evidence integrity was inferred.
The packet omits tests and helper implementations referenced by the included CI entry points, so their behavior was not assessed.
Excluded README sections and all surfaces outside the curated manifest were not reviewed.
This is not full product coverage, skill-accuracy validation, human or sealed review, independent ground truth, or remote model attestation.
